dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It was a great pleasure to enjoy a delicious meal to the gentle whisper of the sea breeze. Thank you for making dinner for everyone, Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: No problem. I'm just glad y'all enjoyed it. I was real worried that I hadn't made enough for everyone... or that I'd made too much.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: By the way, how was your walk today? Find any high-up spots with a good view?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes. The bard's description of an "emerald isle" describes this place perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh? So what about the rest of the story, is that true as well?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's hard to say. But I do believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Well then, let's hope we wake up tomorrow morning to the sight of the Dodo-King or a Dodoco! That'd be fun.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: ...Of course, I don't mind if that doesn't happen. It's amazing just to be here on the island from the story, and to get to make some friends from Mondstadt.
